explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Paducah" (revision 1370452606) says: "One historian has argued that the anger of Forrest's men towards the Black troops who thwarted their attack and refused Forrest's demand to surrender led to the massacre of surrendering Black troops at Fort Pillow, Tennessee two weeks later." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of Paducah caused Battle of Fort Pillow, and nothing more.
